problem_type: Absent review evidence becomes a pass and resets correction budget
symptom: Vision/extraction/judge/parse failures yield empty deviations, then requested shots are reported passed.
direct_cause: Runner/store erase coverage; renderer equates no flags with pass; host accepts unsupported verdicts.
class_root: Assessment provenance is not carried across review orchestration, state, IPC and retry admission.
internal_only_reason: Internal domain provenance defect. Existing review parser, captured project lifecycle and ProductionRun QA remain authoritative; no new external API behavior.
invariants: Only explicit valid nonzero active dimensions establish assessment.
Every requested shot is assessed or explicitly unreviewed.
Unknown evidence cannot pass, reset convergence budget or schedule a retry.
Single-frame evidence never implies whole-video validation.
A retry flag must carry the canonical dimension and a finite positive low score, and that dimension must be present in the same shot assessment.
Late review cannot authorize a new result/attempt, mutate a stopped Run, or advance assembly after its execution snapshot changes.

door_reduction.why_not: Existing judge, store, renderer adapter and Run host remain separate ownership layers; all must preserve the same explicit evidence contract.

generality_proof: Track requested-shot coverage and real assessed dimensions independent of provider, media, failure stage or caller. Failed/omitted evidence is unreviewed at both renderer and Run host boundaries.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Return explicit per-shot assessment and deviations without blocking generation.
Reject unsupported QA evidence before durable retry/budget decisions.
Own exact-evidence QA request, lifecycle reconciliation and durable per-shot retry sequencing.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Missing IDs and unsupported verdicts are unreviewed, never passed/retried.

recurrence.reason: Equivalent empty deviation shape occurs for unavailable vision, frame failure, judge rejection, invalid parse and zero assessable dimensions in both explicit review and ProductionRun.
same_class_scan: Enumerated runner/store, renderer adapter, Run QA summary/retry and judge parser callers using scripts/door-map.mjs.
Read gatherShotVerifyInputs, batchPlanPreview no-auto-review decision and ProductionRun semantic QA attention policy.
Compared unavailable/malformed/partial/zero-dimension outcomes against assessed passes; exercised project lifecycle and concurrent calls.

Refreshed generated door map after whole-owner extraction: isAssessedShotReview, parseShotVerifyVerdict, unreviewedShot, qaVerdictsForRequestedShots, qaInputSnapshot, areRequestedShotsAssessed, buildQaStageOutcome, buildQaRetryPlans, qaAssessmentFixture, verifyShotsAndReport, clampScore, contentDeviationsToReconcile, verifyGeneratedShots, createQaStageRunner, ReconcileDeviation

prevention.invariant: Only actual valid scored dimensions establish assessed evidence; all requested shots retain an explicit outcome.
prevention.failure_mode: Unavailable/invalid/omitted evidence returns unreviewed; generation remains separate; host refuses retry without assessment.
prevention.strategy: Replace array-only review result and no-flags pass inference across the existing owner chain.

legacy_paths.rationale: Array-only return and inferred passes are replaced in the same change; no legacy pass fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal review evidence and lifecycle contracts only; no third-party runtime change.

migration: No project data rewrite. Legacy responses lacking explicit assessment are unreviewed. The new unreleased review metadata uses an assessed boolean instead of introducing a second two-word workflow status vocabulary; absent legacy evidence still fails closed.
residual_risks: Real AI judging excluded. Local fixtures verify orchestration only.
First-frame plus prompt context cannot establish full temporal/face/audio/lip-sync continuity.
